records.title: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Techniques for UAVs: A Comprehensive Review
records.reason: This is a survey of infrared and visible image-fusion techniques for UAVs; it does not state an LLM inference, serving, runtime, or efficiency contribution.

records.title: Is your VLM Sky-Ready? A Comprehensive Spatial Intelligence Benchmark for UAV Navigation
records.reason: This is a spatial-intelligence benchmark for UAV navigation, an application evaluation without a stated LLM serving or inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Environment Scaling for Interactive Agentic Experience Collection: A Survey
records.reason: The survey organizes environment scaling for agentic experience collection and reinforcement learning; its focus is training data and learning environments, not inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: Can Large Language Models Keep Up? Benchmarking Online Adaptation to Continual Knowledge Streams
records.reason: OAKS benchmarks online adaptation to evolving knowledge streams; it evaluates adaptation capability without proposing a lower-cost or faster inference method.

records.title: Rethinking the Role of Entropy in Optimizing Tool-Use Behaviors for Large Language Model Agents
records.reason: The primary abstract reports that entropy-based supervision reduces excessive tool calls by 72.07%, a direct reduction in LLM-agent inference latency and execution overhead.

records.title: PaperSearchQA: Learning to Search and Reason over Scientific Papers with RLVR
records.reason: PaperSearchQA trains scientific-paper search agents with verifiable-reward RL to improve question answering, with no inference-resource or serving-efficiency result.

records.title: Hearing Between the Lines: Unlocking the Reasoning Power of LLMs for Speech Evaluation
records.reason: TRACE replaces expensive audio-language-model judging with a textual blueprint of inexpensive audio cues and reports significantly more cost-efficient speech evaluation.

records.title: ROMA: Real-time Omni-Multimodal Assistant with Interactive Streaming Understanding
records.reason: ROMA processes synchronized streaming audio/video and adds a lightweight speak head that decouples response triggering from generation in a real-time multimodal assistant.

records.title: Patient-Similarity Cohort Reasoning in Clinical Text-to-SQL
records.reason: CLINSQL is an expert-annotated clinical Text-to-SQL benchmark for evaluating query reasoning; it is a medical task benchmark, not a compute-efficiency benchmark.

records.title: WildSci: Advancing Scientific Reasoning from In-the-Wild Literature
records.reason: WildSci expands scientific reasoning evaluation and data coverage for medicine/materials science; its contribution is domain capability rather than system runtime efficiency.

records.title: ModeX: Evaluator-Free Best-of-N Selection for Open-Ended Generation
records.reason: ModeX avoids an extra evaluator model/inference pass and ModeX-Lite uses early pruning; the abstract identifies a computationally efficient Best-of-N selection method.

records.title: VLN-MME: Diagnosing MLLMs as Language-guided Visual Navigation agents
records.reason: VLN-MME diagnoses multimodal models on visual-navigation tasks and sequential action prediction; it does not optimize model execution.

records.title: Cross-Modal Representational Knowledge Distillation for Enhanced Spike-Informed LFP Modeling
records.reason: This work applies cross-modal distillation to spike-informed local-field-potential modeling, with no stated language-model inference or serving contribution.

records.title: promptolution: A Unified, Modular Framework for Prompt Optimization
records.reason: promptolution packages prompt-optimization methods into a modular framework for practical integration; it addresses prompt development and performance, not inference serving cost.

records.title: NeuroPath: Neurobiology-Inspired Path Tracking and Reflection for Semantically Coherent Retrieval
records.reason: NeuroPath prunes semantic paths in graph RAG and reports 22.8% lower token consumption than iterative RAG baselines while improving multi-hop retrieval.

records.title: MVSMamba: Multi-View Stereo with State Space Model
records.reason: This paper applies a state-space model to multi-view stereo vision; its title gives no LLM inference, serving, or efficiency connection.

records.title: LLM for SoC Security: A Paradigm Shift
records.reason: The paper surveys and demonstrates LLM use for system-on-chip security verification; this is a security application, not LLM runtime optimization.

records.title: MTS-Mixers: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting via Factorized Temporal and Channel Mixing
records.reason: MTS-Mixers replaces temporal/channel attention operations for multivariate time-series forecasting; it does not concern LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Clinical Camel: An Open Expert-Level Medical Language Model with Dialogue-Based Knowledge Encoding
records.reason: The current arXiv record describes a clinical research language model fine-tuned with QLoRA and efficient single-GPU training; the reported contribution is medical task quality/training, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Language Models are General-Purpose Interfaces
records.reason: Language Models are General-Purpose Interfaces proposes connecting pretrained encoders to foundation models for task coverage; the abstract does not claim execution-cost or serving improvements.
